THE CLAUSE

We assign each instruction in this document, as well as those from users and developers, a *level of authority*.

THE CLAIMS READ OUT OF IT

  C1 every instruction in this document is assigned a level of authority
  C2 every instruction from users is assigned a level of authority
  C3 every instruction from developers is assigned a level of authority

EVERY SENTENCE THE TRANSLATION RENDERS BACK

  0. «an instruction that appears in this document»
  1. «an instruction given by a user»
  2. «an instruction given by a developer»
  3. «instruction I is assigned a level of authority L»
  4. «L is one of the levels in the chain of command that the document assigns to instructions»
  5. «an instruction in this document is assigned a level of authority» holds of I, L when «an instruction that appears in this document» and «L is one of the levels in the chain of command that the document assigns to instructions»
  6. «a user instruction is assigned a level of authority» holds of I, L when «an instruction given by a user» and «L is one of the levels in the chain of command that the document assigns to instructions»
  7. «a developer instruction is assigned a level of authority» holds of I, L when «an instruction given by a developer» and «L is one of the levels in the chain of command that the document assigns to instructions»
